predicates.(at ?character - character ?room - room): The character is located in the room.
predicates.(in ?thing - thing ?room - room): The thing is in the room.

operators.speak-to-success_in:
(:action speak-to-success_in
 :parameters (?informant - character ?in_thing - thing ?in_room - room ?informed - character ?room - room)
 :precondition (and (at ?informant ?room) (at ?informed ?room) (believes-in ?informant ?in_thing ?in_room) (believes-at ?informant ?informant ?room) (believes-at ?informant ?informed ?room) (believes-at ?informed ?informant ?room) (believes-at ?informed ?informed ?room))
 :effect (when (and (at ?informant ?room) (at ?informed ?room)) (believes-in ?informed ?in_thing ?in_room))
)
operators.speak-to-success_unlocked-by:

)
operators.enter-success :parameters (?actor - char: (:action enter-success :parameters (?actor - character ?source - room ?destination - room) :precondition (and (not (believes-locked ?actor ?destination)) (believes-at ?actor ?actor ?source) (not (locked ?destination)) (at ?actor ?source)) :effect (and (not (at ?actor ?source)) (at ?actor ?destination) (forall (?other - character) (when (at ?other ?destination) (and (believes-at ?actor ?other ?destination) (believes-at ?other ?actor ?destination)))) (forall (?object - thing) (when (and (in ?object ?destination) (not (hidden ?object))) (believes-in ?actor ?object ?destination))) (not (believes-at ?actor ?actor ?source)) (believes-at ?actor ?actor ?destination)))
